buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to

increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 5. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 6. Generic Staggered Delivery: The ordered items shall be supplied in a staggered manner. ( 75 Quantity shall be supplied within 15 days of contract placement and thereafter 75 Quantity per Quarter) 7. Sample Clause After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 5 samples for Buyer's approval, within 5 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 5 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee.

8. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of ESIC FUND ACCOUNT NO 1 payable at FARIDABAD . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of ESIC FUND ACCOUNT NO 1 payable at FARIDABAD . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of ESIC FUND ACCOUNT NO 1 payable at FARIDABAD . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 11. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions (As per GFR 2017 Procurement Guidelines & Transparency Norms) 1. The bidder shall comply with all provisions of General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017, GeM General Terms & Conditions, CVC guidelines and instructions issued by Government of India from time to time regarding p ublic procurement. 2. The bidder shall submit a declaration on the letter head of the company duly signed & stamped for. (a)The bidder shall disclose whether the Proprietor/Partner/Director/Authorized Signatory of the firm/comp any has any relationship with any employee/officer of the Procuring Entity or any member connected with the procurement process. (b)Price Undertaking The Bidder shall also submit an undertaking confirming that if there is any downward revision in the market price of the quoted product during the contract period, the same shall be intimated t o the institution, and the benefit of such reduction shall be passed on to the Buyer. The quoted rates shall remain valid for a period of one (1) year from the date of issuance of the Purchase Order/Contract. (c) The bidder shall ensure that there is no Conflict of Interest affecting fairness, transparency and compet itiveness of the procurement process.

3. The bidder must submit all required documents including: (As Applicable) - PAN Card - GST Registration - Bank Details - Authorization Certificate (if applicable) - OEM Authorization (wherever applicable) - Technical Compliance Sheet - Declaration/Undertaking 4. Sterility of the required product if asked for to be sterile should be ... EO/Radiation or as per the require ment of the quoted product protocol. And certification for the same may be asked by the buyer as and whe n required. 5. Non-submission of mandatory declarations/documents may lead to rejection of the bid. 6. The Procuring Entity reserves the right to verify any document/information submitted by the bidder at any stage. 7. Pricing and Delivery • Rates shall be quoted per unit as reflected in the GeM BOQ/custom/BID, inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, transportation, and delivery charges, on FOR ESIC MCH Faridabad NIT 3 Haryana. 8. Packaging, Transport, and Risk The supplier shall ensure proper packing of goods to prevent damage d uring transit by air, rail, or road. Any loss or damage discovered upon inspection at the consignee’s store s hall be made good by the supplier at no extra cost. The department shall not be liable for any insurance c harges; such costs shall be borne by the supplier. 9. Right to reserve-Competent authority reserve the right to return the reagents/consumable if they remai n unutilized and revoke contract at any period of time if good are not satisfactory and will be returned at c ost of qualified bidder. 10. Shelf Life should be 75 % or more remaining from the date of manufacturing at the time of supply. 11. Expiry- The Bidder shall furnish an undertaking that any unconsumed stock within the contract period shall be replaced with a fresh batch of long expiry at no additional cost to the Buyer. 12. Pre-Bid Clarifications Bidders are advised to carefully read all bid documents. Any query or representa tion may be submitted only through the GeM portal. No representations shall be entertained through any o ther means, and the decision of the procuring authority shall be final and binding. 13. Penalty Clause:- Successful bidder has to supply the goods as per the staggered supply schedule failin g which 0.5%/week penalty of the ordered value will be levied to the maximum of the 10% and failure to s upply the goods in time for more than two times will be liable for deemed action by the competent author ity. 14. Certificates and Licenses To be eligible for award of the contract, the Bidder/OEM must possess and up load the following valid certificates/documents as on the date of bid opening: • Copy of valid Manufacturing License of OEM as applicable • Copy of renewed Manufacturing Authorization, as applicable . The item quoted should have minimum ISO/BIS/European CE/US FDA certifications or its equivalent or as applicable as per specification in each case. .The goods supplied should be certified by the latest amended MDR/CDSCO (as applicable) of govt of India . 15. “If the bidder/contractor/supplier/seller or any employee of the bidder/contractor/supplier/seller or any person acting on behalf of the bidder/contractor/supplier/seller, either directly or indirectly, is a relative of any of the officers/officials (regular/contractual) of Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), or alter natively, if any relative of an officer/official of ESIC has financial interest/stake in the bidder's/contractor's/ supplier's/seller's firm, the same shall be disclosed by the bidder/contractor/supplier/seller at the time of fil ing of the tender/participation in the procurement process .Failure to disclose this information shall result i n cancellation of the bidder’s participation” 16. Each unit pack shall clearly indicate:

-Name of the product -Size/specification -Manufacturer name and address -Batch/Lot Number -Manufacturing Date -Expiry Date -Sterilization method (where applicable) -Regulatory marking (CE/BIS etc.), Where applicable. 17. Bidder should not have been blacklisted or debarred by any Central/State Government/agencies of ce ntral/State Government/PUC/regulatory authority of India at the time of submission of this bid. An undertak ing for this is to be uploaded with the bid document on letter of bidder. 18. The quoted product Should be compatible with Fresenius 4008S NG and 5008S machines .
